title: Radi and Aissam were the best!
text:
Aissam was wonderful in driving us from our hotel to the port and back. He even filled our paperwork for the ferry. Radi was our guide in Tangier and treated us like family! Overall amazing experience! 
I would suggest taking a rain jacket or umbrella and doing a little research ahead of time so you can curate the time spent on different things, to your own liking.
author: RituT_B
